profiles.use_case: Exercise one installed-cadence saved-check tick against a disposable local queue, retain exact evaluation and local-delivery custody, and verify same-slot replay, overlap refusal, and missed-slot no-catch-up behavior.
synthetic_capabilities: The queue and maintenance declaration are disposable local example inputs.
The example invokes the installed-cadence tick directly and does not activate systemd.
NQ runs in debug mode under its explicit same-UID helper exception; this is a single-user local substitution fixture, not the installed release identity boundary.
profiles.example_inputs: A caller-created 20-row SQLite queue, exact regular-file component executables, one fresh absent saved-check-demo-* root, and credential-free local-file notification custody.
profiles.writer_requirement: One operator-owned local example root. Preserve its NQ and Nightshift stores, tick summaries, configurations, command transcript, and inbox together while an outcome is uncertain.
limitations: The example is a finite direct invocation, not a service installer and not evidence of systemd activation.
NQ is deliberately a debug build under its same-UID helper exception. Installed release builds require a distinct enrolled helper account; Nightshift and Monitor remain release builds.
Local-file acceptance does not establish human receipt or acknowledgment, and live Slack or Discord delivery is outside the profile.
Response loss after NQ acceptance is not exercised; inspect the exact retained NQ notification and Nightshift evaluation before considering another invocation.
The example establishes same-slot replay and bounded pre-effect refusals, not general supervisor recovery or unattended operation.
Migration, restore, rollback, and retention rollover are not established.

environment.build_profile: NQ debug with explicit debug-only same-UID helper exception; Nightshift and Monitor release

qualification.scope: qualified public-only anonymous-clone reproduction of the exact installed saved-check local example and retained-state inspection, within the documented debug-helper fixture limits

outside_release: systemd activation and the system installation boundary
migration, restore, rollback, or retention rollover
general supervisor recovery or unattended service operation
